description.value: The Lester Centre of the Arts is Prince Rupert's premier performing arts venue, a 702-seat theatre at the foot of Hays Mountain that has anchored the cultural life of BC's North Coast since opening in 1987 as the Prince Rupert Performing Arts Centre. Renamed in 2006 to honour patrons Peter and Mary Lester, the venue hosts an eclectic mix of theatre, rock concerts, dance recitals, and community events. For touring cyclists passing through Prince Rupert, it is a notable cultural landmark and evening destination.

address.value: 1100 McBride Street, Prince Rupert BC, V8J 3H2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the Lester Centre of the Arts is an active 702-seat performing arts venue at 1100 McBride Street, Prince Rupert BC, with a full upcoming event calendar through 2026-2027, validating it is operational. Phone and address are drawn from the /contact-us subpage; OSM carried no contact fields so contact_confirmed reflects only the website-URL match. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are explicitly named on the site; the /about-the-lester subpage does confirm 'two concession stands,' supporting a food/beverage amenity.
concerns: Front page contains apparent Webflow template placeholder content not yet removed — generic testimonials about 'digital marketing training,' an unrelated 'web seminar' section, and references to media publishers unconnected to the venue. Does not affect legitimacy but suggests the website is only partially customised.

OSM record carries no phone, address, or email — all contact details sourced exclusively from the venue website; contact_confirmed fields for phone and address are null as there were no OSM values to cross-check.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Lester Centre of the Arts is a well-established, actively programming cultural venue and a meaningful destination for touring cyclists exploring BC's North Coast; the contact details and operating status are well-confirmed from the website.

Café or food on site.detail: Website /about-the-lester page states the facility includes 'two concession stands'
